##### Project general facts

The Beach Vista is an exclusive residential development nestled on the pristine shores, offering a limited collection of luxurious residences ranging from studios to spacious two-bedroom apartments. Each unit is a masterpiece, meticulously designed to maximize space, light, and breathtaking views of the Arabian Gulf. The first interactive gaming resort in the MENA region, The Beach Vista provides direct beach access and an unparalleled coastal lifestyle, combining elegance, comfort, and serenity.

Inspired by the beauty of the coastline, The Beach Vista's architecture blends modern elegance with natural surroundings, featuring sleek lines, expansive glass facades, and a terraced structure. Residents enjoy world-class amenities including an infinity pool with panoramic views, a state-of-the-art gym, a resident's club, and concierge services. Private cabanas, sunken loungers, and serene beach access offer relaxation at every turn, creating a perfect retreat for those seeking both tranquility and modern luxury by the sea.

Every apartment at The Beach Vista is fully finished using high-quality modern materials, with fully equipped kitchens and thoughtfully designed interiors that maximize space and light. The meticulous design and premium finishes create residences that are both elegant and functional, offering a sanctuary of comfort and sophistication overlooking the Arabian Gulf.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled on Al Marjan Island, a prestigious man-made archipelago in Ras Al Khaimah that stretches into the Arabian Gulf, this exceptional location is known for its serene environment and luxury waterfront living. Comprised of four coral-shaped islands, the area offers pristine beaches, crystal-clear waters, and scenic views, making it a haven for those seeking a peaceful and upscale lifestyle.

The location is distinguished by its world-class entertainment and leisure offerings. The island is home to a variety of luxury resorts, high-end residential properties, and The Wynn Resort with its future casino, adding a layer of exclusivity and entertainment. Residents enjoy water sports, dining options, and a vibrant community life, all within a well-planned infrastructure with easy access to the rest of Ras Al Khaimah.

For those seeking a residence that embodies coastal elegance, modern luxury, and a prime Ras Al Khaimah address, Al Marjan Island delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of pristine beaches, world-class amenities, and strategic connectivity makes it one of the UAE's premier real estate hotspots. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of seaside living.
